```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(visNetwork)

# ============================================================
# METRICS
# ============================================================

n_publications <- 2893
n_abstracts <- 2743
n_topics <- 4
n_communities <- 3

# ============================================================
# TOPIC DATA
# ============================================================

lda_terms <- tribble(
  ~topic, ~term, ~rank,

  "Topic 1", "research", 1,
  "Topic 1", "work", 2,
  "Topic 1", "political", 3,
  "Topic 1", "analysis", 4,
  "Topic 1", "study", 5,
  "Topic 1", "studies", 6,
  "Topic 1", "different", 7,
  "Topic 1", "health", 8,
  "Topic 1", "theory", 9,
  "Topic 1", "theoretical", 10,

  "Topic 2", "latina", 1,
  "Topic 2", "investigacion", 2,
  "Topic 2", "politica", 3,
  "Topic 2", "centro", 4,
  "Topic 2", "forma", 5,
  "Topic 2", "brasil", 6,
  "Topic 2", "cultura", 7,
  "Topic 2", "teoria", 8,
  "Topic 2", "américa", 9,
  "Topic 2", "analisis", 10,

  "Topic 3", "educación", 1,
  "Topic 3", "políticas", 2,
  "Topic 3", "prácticas", 3,
  "Topic 3", "producción", 4,
  "Topic 3", "relaciones", 5,
  "Topic 3", "diferentes", 6,
  "Topic 3", "analizar", 7,
  "Topic 3", "contexto", 8,
  "Topic 3", "espacio", 9,
  "Topic 3", "formación", 10,

  "Topic 4", "teoría", 1,
  "Topic 4", "ciencia", 2,
  "Topic 4", "siglo", 3,
  "Topic 4", "revista", 4,
  "Topic 4", "libro", 5,
  "Topic 4", "sociedad", 6,
  "Topic 4", "obra", 7,
  "Topic 4", "derecho", 8,
  "Topic 4", "científica", 9,
  "Topic 4", "filosofía", 10
)

# ============================================================
# COLORS
# ============================================================

topic_colors <- c(
  "Topic 1" = "#22D3EE",
  "Topic 2" = "#8B5CF6",
  "Topic 3" = "#EC4899",
  "Topic 4" = "#34D399"
)

# ============================================================
# TF-IDF
# ============================================================

tfidf_terms <- tribble(
  ~term, ~score,

  "social", 100,
  "trabajo", 94,
  "sociales", 91,
  "argentina", 88,
  "política", 85,
  "historia", 81,
  "research", 79,
  "investigación", 77,
  "análisis", 75,
  "estudios", 73,
  "sociology", 71,
  "campo", 69,
  "ciencias", 67,
  "artículo", 65,
  "political", 63,
  "sociología", 61,
  "work", 59,
  "educación", 57,
  "estudio", 55,
  "health", 53
)

# ============================================================
# INTERACTIVE TOPIC NETWORK
# ============================================================

topic_nodes <- tibble(
  id = paste0("T", 1:4),
  label = paste0("TOPIC ", 1:4),
  group = paste0("Topic ", 1:4),
  value = 35,
  title = paste(
    "<b>Topic", 1:4, "</b><br>",
    c(
      "Research & Knowledge",
      "Latin American Sociology",
      "Education & Society",
      "Theory & Culture"
    )
  )
)

term_nodes <- lda_terms %>%
  mutate(
    id = paste0("term_", row_number()),
    group = topic,
    value = 10 + (11 - rank) * 1.5,
    title = paste(
      "<b>", term, "</b><br>",
      topic,
      "<br>Rank:", rank
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    id,
    label = term,
    group,
    value,
    title
  )

network_nodes <- bind_rows(
  topic_nodes,
  term_nodes
)

network_edges <- lda_terms %>%
  mutate(
    from = paste0("T", as.numeric(str_remove(topic, "Topic "))),
    to = paste0("term_", row_number()),
    width = 1 + (11 - rank) / 5
  ) %>%
  select(
    from,
    to,
    width
  )
```

## Row {height=430}

### Research Intelligence

```{r}
topic_plot <- plot_ly()

for (tp in unique(lda_terms$topic)) {

  d <- lda_terms %>%
    filter(topic == tp)

  topic_plot <- topic_plot %>%
    add_trace(
      data = d,
      x = ~rank,
      y = ~term,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "markers",
      name = tp,
      marker = list(
        size = 14,
        color = topic_colors[tp]
      ),
      text = ~paste(
        "<b>", term, "</b>",
        "<br>", topic,
        "<br>Rank:", rank
      ),
      hoverinfo = "text"
    )
}

topic_plot %>%
  layout(
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    font = list(color = "#AAB5C8"),
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Term rank",
      gridcolor = "#1D2738"
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "",
      gridcolor = "#1D2738"
    ),
    legend = list(
      bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
    ),
    height = 360,
    margin = list(
      l = 100,
      r = 30,
      t = 25,
      b = 45
    )
  ) %>%
  config(
    responsive = TRUE
  )
```

## Row {height=500}

### Interactive Topic Network

```{r}
visNetwork(
  network_nodes,
  network_edges
) %>%
  visNodes(
    shape = "dot",
    borderWidth = 1,
    font = list(
      color = "#E8EDF7",
      size = 16,
      face = "Arial"
    ),
    scaling = list(
      min = 8,
      max = 35
    )
  ) %>%
  visGroups(
    groupname = "Topic 1",
    color = list(
      background = "#22D3EE",
      border = "#67E8F9",
      highlight = "#67E8F9"
    ),
    font = list(
      color = "#FFFFFF",
      size = 20,
      face = "Arial"
    )
  ) %>%
  visGroups(
    groupname = "Topic 2",
    color = list(
      background = "#8B5CF6",
      border = "#A78BFA",
      highlight = "#C4B5FD"
    ),
    font = list(
      color = "#FFFFFF",
      size = 20,
      face = "Arial"
    )
  ) %>%
  visGroups(
    groupname = "Topic 3",
    color = list(
      background = "#EC4899",
      border = "#F472B6",
      highlight = "#F9A8D4"
    ),
    font = list(
      color = "#FFFFFF",
      size = 20,
      face = "Arial"
    )
  ) %>%
  visGroups(
    groupname = "Topic 4",
    color = list(
      background = "#34D399",
      border = "#6EE7B7",
      highlight = "#A7F3D0"
    ),
    font = list(
      color = "#FFFFFF",
      size = 20,
      face = "Arial"
    )
  ) %>%
  visEdges(
    color = list(
      color = "#526074",
      highlight = "#22D3EE",
      hover = "#22D3EE"
    ),
    smooth = list(
      enabled = TRUE,
      type = "dynamic"
    ),
    scaling = list(
      min = 1,
      max = 5
    )
  ) %>%
  visPhysics(
    enabled = TRUE,
    solver = "forceAtlas2Based",
    forceAtlas2Based = list(
      gravitationalConstant = -35,
      centralGravity = 0.01,
      springLength = 130,
      springConstant = 0.08,
      damping = 0.4
    ),
    stabilization = list(
      enabled = TRUE,
      iterations = 250
    )
  ) %>%
  visOptions(
    highlightNearest = list(
      enabled = TRUE,
      degree = 1,
      hover = TRUE
    ),
    selectedBy = "group",
    collapse = FALSE
  ) %>%
  visInteraction(
    dragNodes = TRUE,
    dragView = TRUE,
    zoomView = TRUE,
    hover = TRUE,
    navigationButtons = TRUE
  ) %>%
  visLayout(
    randomSeed = 42
  )
```

tfidf_plot <- plot_ly(
  data = tfidf_terms,
  x = ~score,
  y = ~reorder(term, score),
  type = "bar",
  orientation = "h",
  marker = list(
    color = "#22D3EE"
  ),
  text = ~paste(
    "<b>", term, "</b>",
    "<br>Relative TF-IDF:", score

)

  layout(
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
